# mupdf / fuzz_quadratic

mupdf's own fuzz target `fuzz_quadratic` ([source](source/fuzz_quadratic.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over mupdf (ArtifexSoftware/mupdf at 5fe54cef).

cmark-gfm quadratic-behaviour fuzzer: a 10-byte config prefix (splitpoint, repeatlen) expands the input by repeating a slice up to 512 KiB, parses it with the autolink/strikethrough/table/tagfilter extensions and GitHub options, and renders HTML, XML, man, CommonMark, plaintext and LaTeX; every rendering is freed unread (no parse(render_commonmark(doc)) round trip).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against mupdf at commit 5fe54cef.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- abort() if one of the four built-in GFM extension names is not registered; input-independent setup check, trivially true once LLVMFuzzerInitialize registered the core extensions ([lines 68-72](source/fuzz_quadratic.c#L68-L72)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch mupdf` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_quadratic.plain` | 266,656 | `8d544151c159c49d0f21b2682090a7de045cc9cc07dcdcb574a467066df0aa3e` |

| asan | `fuzz_quadratic.asan` | 1,387,384 | `7a5828c212d0320b21805c804a7c52d5f55ef6f757feab294a8e47507fba26f8` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
